classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate one small soluble de novo protein candidate: RFdiffusion produces an unconditional backbone; ESM3 folds and embeds a seed sequence delivering multimodal structure evidence; sequence_analysis characterises composition and motifs; protein_qc returns lightweight solubility scalars; rank_designs aggregates all evidence into a single ranked output.
assumptions: Backbone length is fixed at 80–100 residues; no binding target, motif, or hotspot is provided so unconditional mode is used.

ESM3 is seeded with the GB1 B1-domain sequence (56 aa) as a well-characterised small soluble starting point; ESM3 redesigns sequence and predicts structure via multimodal generation across sequence, structure, and embedding tracks.

ProteinMPNN is not available in the selected tool set; the rfdiffusion backbone is passed directly to rank_designs as a parallel structural candidate while ESM3 provides the sequence-grounded predicted structure.
pH is fixed at 7.4 for charge and pI calculations in both sequence_analysis and protein_qc.
A single ranked candidate (top_k=1) is sufficient for this compact demonstration workflow.
No literature search or ligand-affinity prediction is required; the workflow is purely generative and compositional.

success_criteria.backbone_generated: rfdiffusion returns at least 1 design in top_candidates with length 80–100 residues
success_criteria.esm3_predicted: esm3 returns a non-null predicted_pdb and confidence_scores for the seed sequence
success_criteria.sequence_characterised: sequence_analysis returns metrics including composition, charge, and any flagged liabilities for the candidate sequence
success_criteria.qc_scalars_computed: protein_qc returns all five scalar metrics (pLDDT, polybasic, GRAVY, instability_index, pI) without critical solubility flags
success_criteria.ranked_output_produced: rank_designs returns ranked_json and ranked_tsv with candidate_count >= 1
